articles.title: DUA Villa / Architecture BRIO
articles.summary: DUA Villa is a weekend residence located in Alibaug, designed for a Mumbai-based couple and their three young adult children. As urban dwellers accustomed to the pace and density of city life, they sought a retreat offering proximity to nature without being overwhelmed by it.
